name: Down on the Corner
source:
A Touhou fan VN. It's basically a story about a childish ice fairy who discovers a new use for tables and the silliness that ensues.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=6973]Lemma Soft forums[/url]]
translation:
一部《东方Project》同人视觉小说。故事主要讲述一名孩子气的冰之妖精发现了桌子的新用途，以及随后发生的种种胡闹。

[摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=6973]Lemma Soft forums[/url]]
